d: HSBC aims to be the international bank of choice for affluent customers, supporting their domestic and international banking, and holistic wealth management needs. We help customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs around the world.
q: At least five years’ experience, preferably in retail banking, sales, customer service or branch operations.
Customer service and sales capability: Ability to meet customer needs, deepen relationships, increase cross-sales and attract quality new business.
Operational and credit-policy knowledge: Ability to follow HSBC policies, lending guidelines, delegated authorities, internal controls and applicable UAE regulations.
Compliance and risk-management capability: Knowledge of KYC, AML, sanctions and relevant monitoring requirements, with the ability to identify, investigate and escalate risks.
Process, complaints and service-quality management: Ability to manage complaints, meet SLAs, monitor quality, reduce errors, support audits and improve processes and turnaround times.

A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory.
r: Deliver effective customer service: Serve as the first point of contact, manage customer flow, support the customer journey and resolve service issues within agreed SLAs.
Support sales and relationship growth: Identify relationship growth and cross-selling opportunities, attract quality new business, promote self-service and support branch profitability.

Maintain operational and credit-policy compliance: Conduct activities in line with HSBC policies, lending guidelines, delegated authorities and UAE regulations, escalating matters outside authorized limits.
Manage compliance, AML and sanctions responsibilities: Support relevant investigations, apply KYC and AML procedures, monitor alerts and escalate potential compliance risks appropriately.
Act as the Branch Complaint Management System Champion: Ensure complaints are accurately recorded, correctly routed, monitored and resolved promptly with action owners.
Improve processes, controls and service quality: Reduce errors, improve turnaround times, address audit actions, protect information, report operational losses and strengthen controls.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

We believe diversity brings benefits for our customers, our business and our people. Different ideas and perspectives help us innovate, manage risk and grow the business in a sustainable way. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
